source_of_truth.feature_semantics: UNDEFINED_BY_ARTIFACT: artifact provides width/dtype but no feature-column vocabulary or live encoding specification; do not invent semantics in R2

constraints: all values finite for model execution
row i is the stable model node index i
x.ordering: node rows must remain stable for the lifetime of edge_index and node_map
x.semantics: 21 feature columns are opaque artifact features; column meanings are not defined by the artifact

constraints: row 0 is source index and row 1 is destination index
edge_index.ordering: column order must be deterministic and accompanied by edge_map; artifact may remove self-loops and coalesce before Phase-II masking
edge_index.edge_features: none; no edge feature tensor is accepted by the packaged model contract

_VULN.role: node-level benchmark ground truth; graph label is any positive node

_LINE.role: original node identifiers for localization/evidence mapping

_SAMPLE.role: constant sample/subgraph identifier per packaged graph

sample_labels_all.pkl.type: pickle mapping keyed by sample identifier
sample_labels_all.pkl.role: auxiliary line-label ground truth for evaluation

run_id.semantics: stable identifier for one controlled-host execution; not passed to model

raw_key.semantics: stable unique identifier for each raw audit/event record or normalized causal edge; not passed to model

edge_map.ordering: edge_map[j] describes edge_index[:,j] before artifact normalization

normalization_map.purpose: reversibly map Phase-II edge indices/top-K output back to raw_key/run_id evidence after artifact remove_self_loops/coalesce behavior

output_envelope.model_boundary: top_k_raw_keys are analyst evidence references, not enforcement commands

ordering_and_normalization.canonical_node_order: adapter-defined stable order, persisted in node_map; changing it changes x and edge_index semantics
ordering_and_normalization.canonical_input_edge_order: adapter-defined deterministic order, persisted in edge_map; do not rely on incidental dictionary/file order
ordering_and_normalization.artifact_phase2_normalization: ProvXExplainer removes self-loops, coalesces edge_index, adds remaining self-loops for message passing, then removes self-loops from returned explanation
ordering_and_normalization.duplicate_policy: must be explicit in normalization_map; artifact coalesce can merge duplicate COO columns and a naive one-to-one mapping would be invalid
ordering_and_normalization.top_k_identity: edge_index column/index plus normalized src/dst and raw_key references; weights are float scores 1-sigmoid(mask)

design_gate: Schema is ready for adapter design, but adapter implementation and live event semantics belong to R3/R4, not R2.
